reason: Both catch the same four genuine defects, but Response A adds a fifth item flagging "Effective Termination Date" as undefined, which is the same kind of issue the prompt explicitly says not to flag (a term defined elsewhere in the full agreement, analogous to the Clause 6/Schedule 1 caveat) — a likely false positive that violates the instruction not to report non-existent problems. Response B stays with the four solid defects and even strengthens the notice-conflict and pro-rata points with better supporting detail (lack of carve-out language, concrete same-rate examples across different months).
